benefits.desc: Juniperus communis treats urinary issues because it contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which have antimicrobial and diuretic properties. UTIs are commonly experienced by women due to the shorter urethra, but men, especially those with prostate issues, and children can also be affected. Juniperus communis, or common juniper, has been traditionally used to treat urinary issues due to its diuretic and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms and support urinary health.
benefits.constituents: Juniperus communis treats urinary issues because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which have diuretic and antimicrobial properties. The plant's essential oils also contribute to its effectiveness in alleviating symptoms of urinary tract infections. Alkaloids like juniperine and flavonoids such as quercetin are known for their anti-inflammatory effects. Overall, these natural compounds support urinary health by promoting detoxification and preventing infections.
benefits.study: According to "Acta poloniae pharmaceutica", Juniperus communis, or juniper berry, has a positive effect in treating urinary tract infections at higher concentrations of approximately 5.85 mg/mL.
